items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...how did Robichaud's band compare with Piron's band? You know, Armand J. Piron? INTERVIEWEE: Well, Piron, well, who was the left-hand fiddle player?

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Uh, I was gonna ask you, how did Robichaud's band compare with Piron's band? You know, Armand J. Piron?
Well, Piron, well, who was the left-hand fiddle player?
The left-handed one was Robichaud. I thought it was Piron. Yeah. I think Piron was right-handed and Robichaud was left-handed. Well. And Robichaud was the one at the Lyric.
